controls.name: C-7d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-18T07:17:06.032Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-18T08:17:06.032Z"
        AND host.name == "canary-1"
        AND event.outcome == "failure"
| STATS failed_per_minute = COUNT(*),
        first_in_minute = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_in_minute = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY minute = DATE_TRUNC(1 minute, @timestamp)
| SORT minute ASC
| LIMIT 1000
